# UniGlory Energy

> UniGlory Energy is a California-based wholesale supplier of solar modules,
> BESS (battery energy storage systems), and inverters for solar installers,
> distributors, EPC contractors, and project developers across the United States.

Key facts

- Business name: UniGlory Energy
- Business: wholesale distribution of solar equipment (B2B, not residential retail)
- Based in: Phelan, California, United States, with a Southern California supply and delivery focus
- Market served: United States
- Contact: sales@unigloryenergy.com · +1 442 462 9310
- Website: https://www.unigloryenergy.com/

## Products and services

- Solar modules: PERC and TOPCon modules for residential, commercial, and utility-scale applications, including all-black and bifacial formats. See [Solar modules](https://www.unigloryenergy.com/solar-modules/).
- BESS (battery energy storage systems): LiFePO4 storage from 16 kWh to 6.25 MWh across three tiers. 16 kWh residential units in a stackable storage-only version and an all-in-one with a built-in inverter, a 261 kWh liquid-cooled commercial and industrial cabinet rated at 125 kW, and 5 MWh container skids rated at 5015 or 6250 kWh. Every tier is parallel-capable.
- Hybrid inverters: single-phase 3-15 kW across two series (ELS3-6K and ELS7.5-15K) and three-phase 4-12 kW (EPH series), matched to the modules and BESS specified for each project.
- Supply support: order quantities from single-pallet distribution orders to utility-scale project supply, with project-scale logistics and post-sale support.

## Customers

- Solar installers
- Solar distributors
- EPC contractors
- Project developers

## Frequently asked questions

- Who does UniGlory Energy serve? We serve solar installers, distributors, EPC contractors, and project developers across the United States.
- What products can you supply? Our core portfolio includes solar modules, LiFePO4 battery energy storage systems (BESS) from 16 kWh to 6.25 MWh, and grid-tied or hybrid inverters.
- Can you support project and distribution orders? Yes. We can discuss utility-scale project requirements as well as flexible-quantity orders for distribution and installation businesses.
- Where is UniGlory Energy based? UniGlory Energy is based in Phelan, California, with a Southern California supply and delivery focus.
